formulae.ma7: Unweighted mean of the daily values over the trailing 7 calendar days, inclusive. Emitted only where the window holds at least 3 observations.

meta.note: One point per EIA observation date, so weekends are absent rather than null. This axis is NOT positionally comparable with the weekly files. EIA publishes spot prices with a lag of roughly a week; the last date here is the last one EIA had published when the pipeline ran, not today.
